third-time patterns, block 11: (1) a room yields or keeps a treaty because the other side was there first (titanfall, danganronpa, malaysia); (2) a room cracks or shrinks its own work for a neighbour (stevenuniverse, xenoblade_chronicles, udub); (3) moderators' April Fools makeovers again fill early turns (nine rooms); (4) the canvas field links a work the room did not make or does not report (totallynotrobots, UNLincoln, sakartvelo, kurdistan, GreenEmpire, TransFlagPlace, finland); (5) Green Lattice granting space and asking upkeep (titanfall, TransFlagPlace, leagueoflegends; GreenEmpire's members moving there); (6) r/placestart hosting small rooms as taskbar icons (clubpenguin, hatsune, farmcarrots's proposal); (7) colour factions with three fates (TeamYellowPlace, PurplePixels, GreenEmpire)

closing block 11 (leg A1b-11): 21 rooms read and noted, 466 of 705 in all; validate A1 0 errors, 0 warnings.
